thesis: The speaker argues that the sports analytics industry has evolved primarily through the widespread acceptance of quantitative methods for both player personnel and on-field strategy. He further explains that modern advancements in data quality, such as player tracking and computer vision, allow analysts to focus on the quality of a process rather than just the outcome of an action.
